about: Requests a member might make of their own AI with Kolmi connected over the MCP, and the tool (and arguments) the first call should go to. Run with backend/evals/run_mcp_evals.py; see docs/mcp.md. An `args` value is matched as: a number or enum exactly; a string with {"contains": ...} case-insensitively; {"present": true} only needs it given.
